nodes.title: [MATTES] CREATURE (the whole creature: dog, worm with a top hat ...)
START HERE
widgets_values:
# START HERE
Film yourself, get a creature that acts like you: voice, mouth, expressions, head turns. **ADVANCED**: render + H3 2x upscale + mattes for Nuke / After Effects.

## How to use
1. **Group 1**: load the models (links below).
2. **BODY CLIP**: your take, filmed landscape (portrait clips are cropped to a thin strip), with a mono or stereo sound track (no sound = the run stops), up to 15 s (cut at 15.08 s). iPhone: switch off HDR video or convert the clip to SDR first.
3. **CREATURE SHEET**: front + side view, wearing your clothes, plus a few small expression heads (laughing with teeth, sad, shouting). The expressions carry over much better. A character sheet locks the creature's look across shots; a detailed creature description alone also works for head swaps.
4. **WHAT GETS REPLACED**: what SAM finds and H3 regenerates: `head` (head swap) or `person` (whole body), plus anything on your head that has to go: *head, helmet, phone, camera rig on the helmet*. Avoid *screen, monitor, cable*: they also find screens and cables in the background. Phone, pocket or watch elsewhere in the shot? Drop *phone* from the words. Rig still visible in a wide shot? Add *screen* to the words (it also catches windows and glass, and a framed poster beside you would be replaced too, so check the mask preview and use it only when needed). A rig part far from your head (a phone on a boom, a back monitor) can get redrawn even when the mask covers it: paint your own mask over it, or film without it. Check PREVIEW: regenerated area. Several people: name the one who acts in the words (*head of the man in the middle*) and set PERSON to him (0 = leftmost); check the mask preview; if people swap sides at a cut, render each shot separately. People crossing or leaving the frame: use your own mask.
5. **PROMPT**: the swap, the creature and its acting in one text (below). The sentence about the acting reference is added automatically.
6. **Run.** Check the PREVIEW videos first. Wrong look? Change the SEED. The creature turns back into you after a few seconds (close-ups)? Raise GROW MASK px (room for ears, horns). Big close-up in a group and the creature turns back into the person? Paint your own mask, bigger than the creature. Wide or rig shots: keep it low, the head grows with it.

## Writing the PROMPT
- **The swap**: head: *"Replace only the man's head in the shot with the head of a real donkey exactly as in <Picture 1>"* + the neck growing out of your collar (default). Whole body: *"Replace the whole man in the shot with the character in <Picture 1>, with its own anatomy, not a human body shape."*
- **The creature**: no sheet? Add a few looks (*fur colour, ears, muzzle*). Full body: its anatomy (*one body, no arms*). Animals: *"stays on four legs"*.
- **The acting in one sentence**: *"His face is very expressive and mirrors every expression: he talks, laughs and grins with his mouth wide open."* Your voice drives the mouth, no need to write the dialogue.
- Never name your helmet or rig in a prompt: it makes H3 draw it.
- **Someone else touches you?** Their hand and arm must be INSIDE the regenerated area: SAM `person` does this; if you paint your own mask, paint OVER their hand, never cut a hole for it (a hole makes H3 draw you back). Then say it in the PROMPT: *another person's normal human hand in a light sleeve scratches his back*.

**Your own mask** (After Effects, Resolve ...): switch off NO MANUAL MASK and load a black / white video with the same framing as the body clip (white = regenerate). It replaces the automatic mask and is used exactly as drawn (GROW MASK px is ignored), held over ±3 frames like the automatic one. Trim it exactly like the body clip (same start, same length). Paint it a bit bigger than the creature will be (ears, horns, hair): a mask that hugs your head lets H3 fall back to your face. Close-up and the fur stops above the collar? Paint your own mask down into the shirt.
**Toggles:** NO HEAD-CAM (on), NO MANUAL MASK (on), NO CHARACTER SHEET, NO POSE CONTROL (on), NO UPSCALE, NO MATTES. One camera follows head turns best; the head-cam only helps wide shots with a tiny face. Pose control: only for full-body swaps of creatures with arms and legs (no effect on head swaps), off for animals.
**Outputs** (output/PerfCap, the centre 1890x1080 of a 1920x1080 plate: in AE / Nuke scale them to 1890x1080 and centre them on your plate): `01_render_1344` + your voice, `04_comparison`, `02_render_2688` ProRes, `03_mattes/` (creature, comp, clean plate).
**Settings:** GROW MASK px = size of the regenerated area (head size), FACE CROP = framing of the acting reference, WORKING SIZE 896x512 = fast draft. MATTES > CREATURE: the whole creature incl. what it wears (*worm with a top hat*).
**Speed / memory:** 11.5 s clip = ~18 min + ~7 min upscale. Tested on a 24 GB card. 15 s with upscale needs 64 GB RAM. 15 s with the head-cam needs about 45 GB of free RAM: close other apps. Less than 32 GB VRAM: set CLIPLoader device = cpu. If the nvfp4 text encoder does not load on your card (pre-Blackwell), use qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.

## Models
- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) -> diffusion_models
- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) -> text_encoders (pre-Blackwell card: [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors))
- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16 + minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/vae) -> vae
- [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo) -> loras
- [h3_character_swap_pro4500_1000](https://huggingface.co/akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA) -> loras/H3_community
- [minimax_h3_fun_controlnet_union_2.0_pruned_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/model_patches/minimax_h3_fun_controlnet_union_2.0_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) -> model_patches
- [sam3.1_multiplex_fp16](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam3.1/blob/main/checkpoints/sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors) -> checkpoints
- [minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler) -> latent_upscale_models: [weights](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors), download minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors and rename it to minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors, or pick it in the loader
- DWPose downloads its models (yolox_l, dw-ll_ucoco_384) on the first run: internet needed once.

**Custom nodes:** [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite), [KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), [comfyui_controlnet_aux](https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux), [ComfyUI-H3-FaceRefine](https://github.com/Carasibana/ComfyUI-H3-FaceRefine), [ComfyUI-Mickmumpitz-Nodes](https://github.com/mickmumpitz/ComfyUI-Mickmumpitz-Nodes), [Comfyui-MMH3-UltimateUpscale](https://github.com/bbaudio-2025/Comfyui-MMH3-UltimateUpscale). ComfyUI 0.37 or newer, no --highvram.

*Build 2-2.5 · 2026-10-07 notes 4*
